articles.title: What’s Brewing: Barkov & Marchand nearing return; Turkey 5kate
PREVIEW: Barkov, Marchand return to action vs. Senators

away.summary: The Panthers (14-8-3) are in a tight Atlantic Division race and have gone 4-1-1 in their last six games. Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand are listed in the projected lineup for this game after nearing returns from injuries, though their statuses were described as pending medical clearance in earlier articles. Jonah Gadjovich is out with a neck injury, while Uvis Balinskis and Bokondji Imama are scratched.

returning: detail: activated from injured reserve and expected to return after missing 13 games with an appendectomy
home.summary: The Capitals (11-11-0) have struggled in November, going 2-7-0 and allowing five or more goals in each of their last eight losses. Vincent Desharnais is expected to return from an appendectomy and replace Jack St. Ivany in the lineup, while Jakob Chychrun did not practice Thursday for maintenance. Charlie Lindgren is listed as the backup goalie in the projected lineup.
